review_notes: I read the whole file. It has no @[simp] declarations and no simp-set design. It is one def (`of_additive_of_le_measure`) and several existence theorems. The def's only use is in `exists_extension_of_isSetRing_of_le_measure_of_dense`, and a grep of the Mathlib sources found no other use. That use never needs to unfold the def's coefficient, because it only supplies `m''` and then proves properties of `m'` and `m₁`. So a simp lemma for its application would not help any use here. The `simp`/`simp only` calls in the proofs are local, and I saw no sign of a rewrite loop, competing rules or a wrongly oriented rule. I did not run Lean, so the absence of problems rests on reading alone.
